title: Sparkly ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cone' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#E8A24C'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#C77A2E'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='scoop1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFD1E8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#FF9CC8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='scoop2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#B8F0A0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#6FD94A'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- cone body -->
  <path d='M38 55 L62 55 L52 92 Q50 96 48 92 Z' fill='url(#cone)'/>
  <!-- cone crosshatch -->
  <path d='M41 60 L59 60' stroke='#A85E1E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43 67 L57 67' stroke='#A85E1E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M45 74 L55 74' stroke='#A85E1E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 81 L54 81' stroke='#A85E1E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 60 L49 80' stroke='#A85E1E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 60 L51 80' stroke='#A85E1E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cone top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='12.5' ry='4' fill='#F2B566'/>

  <!-- bottom scoop (green) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='15' fill='url(#scoop2)'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#D6FFC6' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- top scoop (pink) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='14' fill='url(#scoop1)'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='25' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FFE8F3' opacity='0.95'/>

  <!-- cherry -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='5' fill='#FF3B5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.5' cy='14.5' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#FFB3C2'/>
  <path d='M50 11 Q54 5 58 7' stroke='#7FD94A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE94A'>
    <path d='M20 22 L22 28 L28 30 L22 32 L20 38 L18 32 L12 30 L18 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M82 30 L83.6 34.4 L88 36 L83.6 37.6 L82 42 L80.4 37.6 L76 36 L80.4 34.4 Z'/>
    <path d='M74 68 L75.4 71.6 L79 73 L75.4 74.4 L74 78 L72.6 74.4 L69 73 L72.6 71.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M26 66 L27.4 69.6 L31 71 L27.4 72.4 L26 76 L24.6 72.4 L21 71 L24.6 69.6 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <circle cx='14' cy='50' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='52' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='14' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='14' r='1.6'/>
  </g>
</svg>
